results.name: Laocoon and His Sons
results.description:
In Virgil, Laocoön was a priest of Poseidon who was killed with both his sons after attempting to expose the ruse of the Trojan Horse by striking it with a spear. In Sophocles, on the other hand, he was a priest of Apollo, who should have been celibate but had married.

This particular sculpture was made by the unknown artist and is a copy of the original work. 

3D scanned using photogrammetry in Hans Tausens Park in Copenhagen. Capturing of the scupture was done by 4 people/4 cameras by jointly dancing around the sculpture.

 Reconstructed in Reality Capture from about 1000 images. 

![](http://rigsters.com/sketchfab_img/laocoon_3dscan-rigsters.jpg)

results.name: Lwala People Ceremonial Dance Mask
results.description: Carved wood with dark brown encrusted patina & white kaolin of face mask with 5-part carved coiffure, minimal facial features of open slit eyes lined with white kaolin, exaggerated prominent nose, large round keloidal scarification at temples, small C-shaped ears, full open lips & pointed chin, holes around edges for attachment, indigenous rope remnants.

results.name: Bete People Ceremonial Dance Mask
results.description: This carved wood face mask that originated in the Ivory Coast has a dark brown patina with white kaolin highlights. A small carved beard has a woven rope and raffia beard attached to it, and fabric behind it.

results.name: Yoruba People Ceremonial Dance Mask
results.description: Carved wood with dark brown black patina with white kaolin and green vegetable pigment in the form of a male face with strong face, accented raised eyebrows, coffee bead eyes with holes pieced in center for dancer’s viewing, fine nose and mouth, 3 pattern scarification emphasized with green coloring, 4 lined scarification around outer edges of face, diamond-shaped ears with white kaolin, prominent lined beard, white colored band at hairline, double row of carved notched motifs, flat top with large upright projection with wider piece flowing backward with dark coloration, holes around perimeter for attachment, evidence of extensive prolonged use.

results.name: Creepy Skinny Dancing Guy
results.description: This guy is skinny but muscular, his face is awkward, he dances in a disturbing way, perfect for making people uncomfortable.

results.name: Senufo People Kepele Ceremonial Dance Mask
results.description: This mask of a human face has a bird sitting on his forhead, leaning down with wings outstretched. A pair of animal horns are on either side of the face, and long whiskers descend from the mouth. This is one-of-a-kind bronze created by lost wax casting and has a dark brown patina.

results.name: Guro People Ceremonial Dance Mask
results.description: From the Guro People of Cote D' Ivoire. Carved wood with polychrome paint of primarily purple female face with red lips, open mouth with white filed teeth, downcast open slit eyes rimmed with black, facial scarification, delicate ears with earring holes, elaborately carved & detailed coiffure with side braids and larger center braid supported by a rectangular geometric patterned piece, holes for attachment around outer rim and mouth stick.

results.name: Punu People Ceremonial Dance Mask
results.description: From the Punu People of Equitorial Guinea. Carved wood with fine aged encrusted dark brown black vegetable pigment& white kaolin patina of a mask in the form of a human face, probably female, covered primarily in kaolin with forehead, temple & cheek scarification, eyelid area, ears & lips accented with dark brown black vegetable pigment coloration, unusual pair breast-like forms on top of mask as well as unusual scalloped design around the perimeter of the mask which is also pierced for attachment, signs of age and use.
